messages.subject: Re: An error has occurred : Connection attempts were not successful before canceled
parts:
Does it work locally? If not, try the shiny-discuss group for general Shiny help.

If it does, look at the Debugging your application section of the documentation. What is in your logs? What is in your Javascript console?
Is your application memory intensive? If so, have you tried using a larger instance type?
